The pinned user schema has two oneOf alternatives, both explicitly string, for account usernames and email addresses. Supplied identifiers are forwarded unchanged.

Returns optional ActiveSync, non-SSL and SSL connection settings, optional calendar/address-book lists and the selected user. Optional fields remain omitted, empty lists remain empty, and integer port and 0/1 fields retain their source types. No nullable fields are inferred.

Connection configuration, account identifiers, calendar/contact descriptions, names, paths and URLs may be private payload data. Returned URLs are not fetched and no CalDAV, CardDAV or ActiveSync connection is made. This read does not establish certificate trust, successful client authentication or access enforcement.
